principles: Match the CLAUDE.md flow-fact double-layer contract: prompt/early guidance plus a hardcoded gate fallback
Edit the managed-asset generation source, never hand-edit generated .claude artifacts
Forward-looking and diff/story-scoped: never flag legacy Chinese
Single source of truth for CJK detection, with a self-contained hook copy kept in sync by a test
drivers: A memory-only rule was violated even when loaded, so enforcement must fire at the action point and at a hard gate
The repository is full of legacy Chinese, so any whole-repo scan would be unusable

options.name: B: warn hook plus validate gate
pros: immediate signal at action point plus hard gate at REVIEW to TEST
low false-positive risk via warn-only layer 1 and narrow scope
cons: touches generation source (init-assets plus managed-assets) and validate preflight
duplicates a tiny CJK regex into the self-contained hook

options.name: C: single blocking hook only
cons: higher false-positive risk blocking legit Bash
no gate-layer coverage if settings not reloaded mid-session

chosen: B: warn hook plus validate gate
rationale: Option B implements the double-layer contract: layer 1 warn-only hook gives an immediate signal where the B-4fd3 miss happened, and layer 2 validate gate is the mechanical hard stop before REVIEW to TEST. Narrow scope (commits plus author-controlled story metadata) and diff/story-scoping keep false positives near zero and never touch legacy files. A is already disproven; C lacks the hard gate and risks blocking legitimate Bash.

preMortem.trigger: Agent legitimately greps or echoes Chinese in a Bash command
preMortem.mitigation: Layer 1 is warn-only (exit 0) and only inspects git commit and lattice story-metadata commands, not arbitrary Bash

preMortem.trigger: Validate scans the whole tree instead of the current story diff
preMortem.consequence: Every story fails and the gate is disabled in frustration
preMortem.mitigation: Scope strictly to git log main..HEAD commit messages and the current story author-controlled metadata; add a test asserting a legacy file outside the story is not flagged

preMortem.scenario: Hook regex drifts from the core detector
preMortem.trigger: CJK ranges updated in core but not in the self-contained hook copy
preMortem.consequence: Layer 1 and layer 2 disagree on what counts as CJK
preMortem.mitigation: A keep-in-sync test asserts the hook copy and the core detector cover the same ranges

preMortem.trigger: Hook added by hand-editing .claude/settings.json instead of the generator
preMortem.consequence: lattice check reports managed-asset drift and future init overwrites it
preMortem.mitigation: Add the hook to init-assets getClaudeHooks plus mergeClaudeHooks and verify lattice check reports settings in sync
